data: What is the approximate log-likelihood of the blue line in the leftmost plot at 18 iterations?

The question asks for the approximate log-likelihood of the blue line in the leftmost plot at 18 iterations. From the caption, we know that the figure shows the increase in log-likelihood scaled by 10e+07. The leftmost plot corresponds to the "Movies" domain. At 18 iterations, the blue line appears to be around -35 on the y-axis. Therefore, the approximate log-likelihood is -35.
